schema.title: Copilot Organization Details
schema.description: Information about the seat breakdown and policies set for an organization with a Copilot Business or Copilot Enterprise subscription.

seat_breakdown.title: Copilot Seat Breakdown
seat_breakdown.description: The breakdown of Copilot Business seats for the organization.

total.description: The total number of seats being billed for the organization as of the current billing cycle.

added_this_cycle.description: Seats added during the current billing cycle.

pending_cancellation.description: The number of seats that are pending cancellation at the end of the current billing cycle.

pending_invitation.description: The number of users who have been invited to receive a Copilot seat through this organization.

active_this_cycle.description: The number of seats that have used Copilot during the current billing cycle.

inactive_this_cycle.description: The number of seats that have not used Copilot during the current billing cycle.

public_code_suggestions.description: The organization policy for allowing or blocking suggestions matching public code (duplication detection filter).

ide_chat.description: The organization policy for allowing or disallowing Copilot Chat in the IDE.

platform_chat.description: The organization policy for allowing or disallowing Copilot features on GitHub.com.

cli.description: The organization policy for allowing or disallowing Copilot in the CLI.

seat_management_setting.description: The mode of assigning new seats.

plan_type.description: The Copilot plan of the organization, or the parent enterprise, when applicable.

422.description: There is a problem with your account's associated payment method.

total_seats.description: Total number of Copilot seats for the organization currently being billed.

items.title: Copilot Business Seat Detail
items.description: Information about a Copilot Business seat assignment for a user, team, or organization.

assigning_team.description: The team through which the assignee is granted access to GitHub Copilot, if applicable.

oneOf.title: Team
oneOf.description: Groups of organization members that gives permissions on specified repositories.

type.description: The ownership type of the team

organization_id.description: Unique identifier of the organization to which this team belongs

enterprise_id.description: Unique identifier of the enterprise to which this team belongs

parent.title: Team Simple
parent.description: Groups of organization members that gives permissions on specified repositories.

name.description: Name of the team

permission.description: Permission that the team will have for its repositories

privacy.description: The level of privacy this team should have

notification_setting.description: The notification setting the team has set

ldap_dn.description: Distinguished Name (DN) that team maps to within LDAP environment

type.description: The ownership type of the team

organization_id.description: Unique identifier of the organization to which this team belongs

enterprise_id.description: Unique identifier of the enterprise to which this team belongs

oneOf.title: Enterprise Team
oneOf.description: Group of enterprise owners and/or members

sync_to_organizations.description: Retired: this field will not be returned with GHEC enterprise teams.

group_name.description: Retired: this field will not be returned with GHEC enterprise teams.

pending_cancellation_date.description: The pending cancellation date for the seat, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. This will be null unless the assignee's Copilot access has been canceled during the current billing cycle. If the seat has been cancelled, this corresponds to the start of the organization's next billing cycle.

last_activity_at.description: Timestamp of user's last GitHub Copilot activity, in ISO 8601 format.

last_activity_editor.description: Last editor that was used by the user for a GitHub Copilot completion.

last_authenticated_at.description: Timestamp of the last time the user authenticated with GitHub Copilot, in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the assignee was last granted access to GitHub Copilot, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: **Closing down notice:** This field is no longer relevant and is closing down. Use the `created_at` field to determine when the assignee was last granted access to GitHub Copilot. Timestamp of when the assignee's GitHub Copilot access was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

plan_type.description: The Copilot plan of the organization, or the parent enterprise, when applicable.

schema.description: The total number of seats created for members of the specified team(s).

422.description: Copilot Business or Enterprise is not enabled for this organization, billing has not been set up for this organization, a public code suggestions policy has not been set for this organization, or the organization's Copilot access setting is set to enable Copilot for all users or is unconfigured.

schema.description: The total number of seats set to "pending cancellation" for members of the specified team(s).

422.description: Copilot Business or Enterprise is not enabled for this organization, billing has not been set up for this organization, a public code suggestions policy has not been set for this organization, or the organization's Copilot access setting is set to enable Copilot for all users or is unconfigured.

schema.description: The total number of seats created for the specified user(s).

422.description: Copilot Business or Enterprise is not enabled for this organization, billing has not been set up for this organization, a public code suggestions policy has not been set for this organization, or the organization's Copilot access setting is set to enable Copilot for all users or is unconfigured.

schema.description: The total number of seats set to "pending cancellation" for the specified users.

422.description: Copilot Business or Enterprise is not enabled for this organization, billing has not been set up for this organization, a public code suggestions policy has not been set for this organization, the seat management setting is set to enable Copilot for all users or is unconfigured, or a user's seat cannot be cancelled because it was assigned to them via a team.

items.title: Copilot Usage Metrics
items.description: Copilot usage metrics for a given day.

date.description: The date for which the usage metrics are aggregated, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

total_active_users.description: The total number of Copilot users with activity belonging to any Copilot feature, globally, for the given day. Includes passive activity such as receiving a code suggestion, as well as engagement activity such as accepting a code suggestion or prompting chat. Does not include authentication events. Is not limited to the individual features detailed on the endpoint.

total_engaged_users.description: The total number of Copilot users who engaged with any Copilot feature, for the given day. Examples include but are not limited to accepting a code suggestion, prompting Copilot chat, or triggering a PR Summary. Does not include authentication events. Is not limited to the individual features detailed on the endpoint.

copilot_ide_code_completions.description: Usage metrics for Copilot editor code completions in the IDE.

total_engaged_users.description: Number of users who accepted at least one Copilot code suggestion, across all active editors. Includes both full and partial acceptances.

languages.description: Code completion metrics for active languages.

items.description: Usage metrics for a given language for the given editor for Copilot code completions.

name.description: Name of the language used for Copilot code completion suggestions.

total_engaged_users.description: Number of users who accepted at least one Copilot code completion suggestion for the given language. Includes both full and partial acceptances.

items.description: Copilot code completion metrics for active editors.

name.description: Name of the given editor.

total_engaged_users.description: Number of users who accepted at least one Copilot code completion suggestion for the given editor. Includes both full and partial acceptances.

models.description: List of model metrics for custom models and the default model.

name.description: Name of the model used for Copilot code completion suggestions. If the default model is used will appear as 'default'.

is_custom_model.description: Indicates whether a model is custom or default.

custom_model_training_date.description: The training date for the custom model.

total_engaged_users.description: Number of users who accepted at least one Copilot code completion suggestion for the given editor, for the given language and model. Includes both full and partial acceptances.

languages.description: Code completion metrics for active languages, for the given editor.

items.description: Usage metrics for a given language for the given editor for Copilot code completions.

name.description: Name of the language used for Copilot code completion suggestions, for the given editor.

total_engaged_users.description: Number of users who accepted at least one Copilot code completion suggestion for the given editor, for the given language. Includes both full and partial acceptances.

total_code_suggestions.description: The number of Copilot code suggestions generated for the given editor, for the given language.

total_code_acceptances.description: The number of Copilot code suggestions accepted for the given editor, for the given language. Includes both full and partial acceptances.

total_code_lines_suggested.description: The number of lines of code suggested by Copilot code completions for the given editor, for the given language.

total_code_lines_accepted.description: The number of lines of code accepted from Copilot code suggestions for the given editor, for the given language.

copilot_ide_chat.description: Usage metrics for Copilot Chat in the IDE.

total_engaged_users.description: Total number of users who prompted Copilot Chat in the IDE.

items.description: Copilot Chat metrics, for active editors.

name.description: Name of the given editor.

total_engaged_users.description: The number of users who prompted Copilot Chat in the specified editor.

models.description: List of model metrics for custom models and the default model.

name.description: Name of the model used for Copilot Chat. If the default model is used will appear as 'default'.

is_custom_model.description: Indicates whether a model is custom or default.

custom_model_training_date.description: The training date for the custom model.

total_engaged_users.description: The number of users who prompted Copilot Chat in the given editor and model.

total_chats.description: The total number of chats initiated by users in the given editor and model.

total_chat_insertion_events.description: The number of times users accepted a code suggestion from Copilot Chat using the 'Insert Code' UI element, for the given editor.

total_chat_copy_events.description: The number of times users copied a code suggestion from Copilot Chat using the keyboard, or the 'Copy' UI element, for the given editor.

copilot_dotcom_chat.description: Usage metrics for Copilot Chat in GitHub.com

total_engaged_users.description: Total number of users who prompted Copilot Chat on github.com at least once.

models.description: List of model metrics for a custom models and the default model.

name.description: Name of the model used for Copilot Chat. If the default model is used will appear as 'default'.

is_custom_model.description: Indicates whether a model is custom or default.

custom_model_training_date.description: The training date for the custom model (if applicable).

total_engaged_users.description: Total number of users who prompted Copilot Chat on github.com at least once for each model.

total_chats.description: Total number of chats initiated by users on github.com.

copilot_dotcom_pull_requests.description: Usage metrics for Copilot for pull requests.

total_engaged_users.description: The number of users who used Copilot for Pull Requests on github.com to generate a pull request summary at least once.

repositories.description: Repositories in which users used Copilot for Pull Requests to generate pull request summaries

name.description: Repository name

total_engaged_users.description: The number of users who generated pull request summaries using Copilot for Pull Requests in the given repository.

models.description: List of model metrics for custom models and the default model.

name.description: Name of the model used for Copilot pull request summaries. If the default model is used will appear as 'default'.

is_custom_model.description: Indicates whether a model is custom or default.

custom_model_training_date.description: The training date for the custom model.

total_pr_summaries_created.description: The number of pull request summaries generated using Copilot for Pull Requests in the given repository.

total_engaged_users.description: The number of users who generated pull request summaries using Copilot for Pull Requests in the given repository and model.
